description: A robed, white-bearded sage with a topknot floats in glowing golden clouds, arms outstretched, above misty pine-covered mountains. In the lower right, a bearded man with a topknot kneels on a rocky outcrop with his hands pressed together in prayer, gazing up at him. Dark, moody oil-painting style with no visible text, border or frame; the painting runs edge to edge.
